description: Get a .blend of one of the user's OWN Blender models (from r3_blender_list) to open in Blender: the current version, or the version fileId names. Answers a one-time download ticket (5 minutes) and the download endpoint (URL, method, Authorization header); the response body is the file. When the current version is the copy R3 made by applying modifiers, the answer says so and names the original upload, with its modifiers intact, to download instead. Another user's model cannot be downloaded.

blenderModelId.description: The Blender model, from r3_blender_list (one of the user's own).

fileId.description: A version's sha256 (from this tool's answer, e.g. the original of an applied copy). Leave out for the current version.

name: r3_blender_download

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Download one of your Blender models as a .blend
